passages.note: Press release quotes Kavanagh backing three ICE-cooperation bills he sponsored, showing a pro-deportation direction without fixing a scope.

rows.reasoning: Kavanagh's own quotes back SB 1294 (housing 'criminal illegal aliens' for ICE), SB 1299 (immigration-enforcement training grants), and SB 1610 (county detention facilities must give ICE information on 'an arrested person'), saying 'we are supporting the federal government's deportation efforts' and 'we will stand with President Trump in this mission.' This shows a pro-deportation-enforcement direction but does not establish whether the line is 'convicted of serious violent crimes' (rung 2), 'all... starting with those who have criminal records' (rung 4), or mass deportation 'including long-settled families and workers' (rung 5): SB 1610's trigger is any 'arrested person,' not conviction of a serious violent crime.

quotes.text: This measure is a no-brainer. The federal government should have access to the empty Marana Prison to house these dangerous criminal illegal aliens so that Arizonans are protected from further threats

With this bill, we are supporting the federal government's deportation efforts by requiring detention facilities to supply inmate information to ICE. We will stand with President Trump in this mission and look forward to seeing these bills advance to the Governor for her signature.
